LanguageData.VGE_AuxiliaryAstrofuelTank.description: A compact, low-volume astrofuel storage tank that supplies fuel for thrusters on a Hellion.
LanguageData.VGE_AuxiliaryOxygenTank.description: A compact, low-volume oxygen tank that supplies oxygen to pumps throughout the Hellion.
LanguageData.VGE_TargetingConsole.description: A large targeting console capable of managing up to three Hellion artillery pieces. Requires a crew member to manually aim and fire the weapons. It draws power directly from the Hellion engine.
LanguageData.VGE_GaussHowitzer.description: A triple-barrel electromagnetic artillery piece that fires dense uranium slugs at high velocity. Designed for both local bombardment and long-range engagements, it can also target other Hellions in orbit. Requires a linked targeting terminal with an operator to function. It draws power directly from the Hellion engine.
LanguageData.VGE_JavelinLauncher.description: A heavy multi-tube missile platform that fires twelve long-range guided astrofuel javelins. Designed for saturation strikes against surface targets and enemy Hellions in orbit, it requires a linked targeting terminal with an operator and draws power directly from the Hellion engine.
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipMinigunTurret.label: Hellion minigun turret
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipMinigunTurret.description: A compact Hellion-mounted heavy automatic turret. Its multi-barrel mechanism unleashes sustained fire at high speed, shredding lightly armored targets at mid-range. It may explode when damaged.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_GravshipMinigun.label: Hellion minigun
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipAutocannonTurret.label: Hellion autocannon turret
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipAutocannonTurret.description: A compact Hellion-mounted automatic turret. Its large-caliber shells do heavy damage over significant ranges, but the barrel must be refurbished after heavy use. It cannot fire at close targets and may explode when damaged. Needs to be constructed on substructure.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_GravshipAutocannon.label: Hellion autocannon
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipUraniumSlugTurret.label: Hellion uranium slug turret
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipUraniumSlugTurret.descriptio: A compact Hellion-mounted armor-piercing turret. Its ultra-dense uranium shells can punch through heavy armor, but it requires new uranium slugs after use. It is more accurate at longer ranges and cannot fire at close targets. May explode when damaged. Needs to be constructed on substructure.
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_GravshipUraniumSlug.label: Hellion uranium slug gun
LanguageData.VGE_Gun_JavelinLauncher.description: A multi-tube javelin launcher for Hellion use. Requires a linked, manned targeting terminal to operate.
LanguageData.VGE_AnticraftEmitter.description: A large, Hellion-mounted energy weapon that projects a concentrated cutting beam capable of slicing through armor and hull plating. Designed to counter enemy Hellions in orbit, it unleashes devastating continuous fire. Requires a linked targeting terminal with an operator to function. Uses a great deal of power when firing.
LanguageData.VGE_LargeGravshipShieldGenerator.label: large Hellion shield generator
LanguageData.VGE_LargeGravshipShieldGenerator.descrip: A large-scale shielding device that can protect a Hellion. It modulates the lift field to create a short-lived momentum-repulsor surface that blocks projectiles. Those inside can still shoot out. It must be charged before use. Active shields generate structural heat which, if not absorbed by heatsinks, will be vented into the Hellion. One Hellion can support two large shield generators.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedLargeOxygenTank.description: This massive tank once held the Hellion's life support supply, but it is now ruptured and useless. Its structure can still yield a good amount of scrap metal.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedLargeChemfuelTank.descripti: The shattered remains of a massive astrofuel storage tank once used to supply a Hellion's thrusters. Its frame still holds recoverable materials.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGiantAstrofuelTank.descript: The shattered remains of a monumental astrofuel storage tank once used to supply a Hellion's thrusters. Its frame still holds recoverable materials.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedLargeHeatsink.description: This large heatsink once cooled a Hellion's systems, but it has burned out. Some steel can still be recovered from the wreck.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedAstropurifier.description: A destroyed control unit that once enhanced the precision and stability of astrofuel refinement. It is now broken beyond repair.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedFuelOptimizer.description: A destroyed control unit that once coordinated the Hellion engine's lift with conventional thrusters. It is now nothing but scrap.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGiantThruster.description: This colossal thruster once propelled massive Hellions through orbit, but it is now a wreck of twisted metal. Its sheer size leaves a substantial haul of salvageable materials.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravtechConsole.label: destroyed Hellion telemetry console
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravtechConsole.description: A shattered interface once used to analyze flight data. Its screens are dark, and its delicate analysis components are twisted beyond repair. It is now useful only as salvage.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedFlightComputer.description: A destroyed REPCONN guidance computer that once optimized flight-data collection. It can be disassembled for any components that remain.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravcorePowerCell.label: destroyed reactor-core power cell
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravcorePowerCoil.label: destroyed reactor-core power coil
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravcorePowerCoil.descripti: A massive reactor assembly, now utterly destroyed, with its reinforced coils twisted and inert. It can be salvaged for valuable components.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedWarComputer.description: The shattered remains of a warcomputer. Its advanced tactical processors are offline and unresponsive, but the core housing contains an intact reactor core that can still be salvaged.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravlockTether.description: The ruined remains of a gravlock tether that once anchored an orbital station. Its stabilization systems are shattered, but its bulky frame can still be deconstructed for valuable salvage, including a reactor core.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedLargeElectricThruster.descr: This powerful thruster once propelled a Hellion through space, but it now lies broken. Even ruined, it contains useful salvage.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGiantElectricThruster.descr: This colossal thruster once propelled massive Hellions through orbit, but it is now a wreck of twisted metal. Its sheer size leaves a substantial haul of salvageable materials.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedPilotCockpit.description: The remains of a Hellion Fighter's control interface, shattered and useless for piloting, but still containing salvageable scrap metal.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedPilotConsole.description: The remains of a Hellion's control interface, shattered and useless for piloting, but still containing salvageable scrap metal.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedPilotBridge.description: The remains of a Hellion Carrier's control interface, shattered and useless for piloting, but still containing salvageable scrap metal.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGunnerSubpersonaCore.descri: A shattered and inert Hellion gunnery core. The advanced processing unit that once housed a specialized combat subpersona is cracked, and the core's connection ports are twisted and useless. It can be salvaged for complex components.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravFieldAmplifier.descript: The shattered remains of an advanced device that once dramatically increased a Hellion's size and build area. The primary systems are destroyed, but a reactor core may still be salvaged from the wreckage.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedMaintenanceHub.description: A completely destroyed system that used to optimize and automate maintenance routines across a Hellion. Can be salvaged for some resources.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedEngineeringConsole.descript: A shattered interface that was used to monitor the maintenance status of all Hellion components. Can be salvaged for scrap.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravjumperEngine.label: destroyed Hellion Fighter engine
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravjumperEngine.descriptio: The mangled remains of a Hellion Fighter engine, now useless for short-range jumps. The lift-field collapse did not cause a detonation, so a valuable reactor core can still be salvaged.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravEngine.label: destroyed Hellion engine
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravEngine.description: The collapsed remains of a Hellion engine, no longer capable of lifting the aircraft. The lift-field collapse did not cause a detonation, so a valuable reactor core can still be salvaged.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravhulkEngine.label: destroyed Hellion Carrier engine
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravhulkEngine.description: The huge, destroyed wreck of a Hellion Carrier engine, no longer operational. The lift-field collapse did not cause a detonation, so a valuable reactor core can still be salvaged.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedSmallWeaponPlatform.descrip: The remains of a small Hellion artillery platform, twisted and wrecked after the destruction of the weapon it once held. Now only useful as salvage.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedMediumWeaponPlatform.descri: The remains of a medium Hellion artillery platform, twisted and wrecked after the destruction of the weapon it once held. Now only useful as salvage.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedLargeWeaponPlatform.descrip: The remains of a large Hellion artillery platform, twisted and wrecked after the destruction of the weapon it once held. Now only useful as salvage.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedGravlunchCloaker.descriptio: The shattered remains of a gravlaunch cloaker that once masked a Hellion's energy signature. While it can no longer hide launch signatures, its frame and components can still be salvaged.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedSmallElectricThruster.descr: This thruster once powered a Hellion, but it is now wrecked beyond use. Metal and components can still be salvaged.
LanguageData.VGE_DestroyedAuxiliaryOxygenTank.descrip: This compact tank once supplied oxygen to a Hellion, but it is now broken and useless. Some steel can still be salvaged from it.
